findings.title: Handaxe and Javelin missing from explicit acquisition paths
findings.description: Handaxe and Javelin (2 of 27 tiered base weapons) are not referenced in STRUCTURE_LOOT, MOB_DROPS, or VILLAGER_TRADES catalogs. These weapons can only be acquired through crafting recipes or as random Netherite drops from the Warden boss.
findings.evidence: Grep confirms handaxe and javelin absent from AcquisitionCatalog.kt. All other 25 tiered melee+thrown weapons have explicit loot/trade entries.
findings.impact: Players may find it difficult to discover these weapons in survival mode without crafting.
findings.suggestedFix: Add handaxe and javelin to structure loot tables or villager trades. Review Phase 5 design intent to confirm if crafting-only availability is expected.

findings.title: Language keys for vanilla-mapped weapons (expected design pattern)
findings.description: Translation keys exist for 4 vanilla-mapped weapons that do not have item JSONs or textures, as these use vanilla items. This is expected per Phase 4 design.
findings.evidence: Language keys present for shortsword, shortbow, light_crossbow, trident; no model JSONs per design.
findings.impact: None. Expected pattern per Phase 4 design.

findings.title: Smithing template recipes correctly implemented
findings.description: Smithing templates use correct '_assemble' suffix with minecraft:smithing_transform recipe type.

findings.title: All 96 registered items have complete data (100% coverage)
findings.description: Verified complete data across: 96 item JSON models, 96 PNG textures, 98 recipes, 100 language keys.
findings.evidence: File inventory: 96 JSONs, 96 textures, 98 recipes (96 weapons + 2 template assembles), 100 language keys.
findings.impact: All 96 items fully configured and ready for in-game use.

findings.title: All tooltip and smithing UI language keys complete
findings.description: 29 tooltip language keys defined: 11 property, 10 smithing, 4 bonus, 3 damage-type, 1 stat-block.
findings.evidence: All expected tooltip.dndweapons.* keys present for properties, smithing UI, bonuses, damage types.
findings.impact: Tooltips render correctly with full translations.

findings.title: Non-tiered ranged weapons correctly excluded from tiering per Phase 4 design
findings.description: ALL_TIERED correctly produces 81 items (27 specs × 3 tiers) by filtering to melee+thrown only, per Phase 4 design decision.
findings.evidence: Filter excludes 7 ranged and 4 vanilla-mapped specs as designed.
findings.impact: Correct per specification. Ranged weapons not tiered due to art burden.

findings.title: Acquisition catalog validation lacks inverse coverage check
findings.description: The validate() function checks referenced weapons exist but does NOT verify all 27 tiered weapons have acquisition paths. Gaps in handaxe/javelin coverage undetected.
findings.evidence: Handaxe and javelin missing from all acquisition sources but not flagged as validation errors.
findings.impact: Incomplete acquisition coverage undetected at startup.
findings.suggestedFix: Add reverse-check: verify each tiered weapon appears in at least one acquisition source.

findings.title: Wiki generation complete for all specs and categories
findings.description: WikiGen renders pages for all 38 weapon specs and all 4 category indexes.
findings.impact: All weapons have wiki documentation framework.
